faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SkillHub — for clients, Pros, and businesses.
faq.paymentInfo: Payments via bank transfer, mobile money, digital wallet or online banking · Admin-verified within 24 hours

items.q: Is it free to use SkillHub as a client?
items.a: Yes — browsing profiles, searching services, and posting jobs is completely free. You only pay the Pro or business directly for their service.

A 30% deposit is paid directly to the Pro once you agree on a rate. The remaining 70% is released by you after the work is confirmed complete. If something goes wrong before you release payment, raise a dispute and our team will mediate.

items.q: How do I contact a Pro or business?
items.a: Create a free account and log in — contact details (phone, WhatsApp, social links) are only shown to authenticated users. This ensures all interactions stay traceable and both parties are protected.

items.q: What if I'm not happy with the work?
items.a: You can raise a dispute directly from your dashboard. Our team reviews the case, considers the Pro's SkillHub Score history, and mediates a fair resolution.
Yes. Individual Pros are verified with a government-issued photo ID. Businesses are reviewed and approved by our admin team before appearing publicly.

Clients browse Pros by category and district, review profiles and scores, then send a job request directly to the Pro they choose. Free plan Pros can receive up to 3 requests per month. Pro and Elite Pros get unlimited requests with priority placement in search results.

items.q: What's the difference between Free, Pro, and Elite?
items.a: Free gets you listed with a basic profile and up to 3 leads/month. Pro ($9/mo) unlocks unlimited leads, portfolio gallery, service offer cards, social links, and priority in search results. Elite ($19/mo) adds featured placement on the landing page and top-of-search positioning.

items.q: How is my SkillHub Score calculated?
items.a: Your score (0–100) is based on five factors: job completion rate, client star ratings, responsiveness to enquiries, dispute history, and trust signals — ID verification, trade certification, and referral history. Unverified Pros are capped at 70.

Subscriptions are monthly. You can see your expiry date on your dashboard. To renew, submit a new payment via bank transfer, mobile money, digital wallet or online banking before the expiry date — your plan downgrades to Free automatically if it lapses.

items.q: Can I show my portfolio and service pricing?
items.a: Yes — Pro and Elite plan Pros can upload up to 12 portfolio photos and create up to 5 (Pro) or 10 (Elite) service offer cards with titles, descriptions, price ranges, and delivery times.

items.q: How do I register my business?
items.a: Click "Join as Pro or Business", select the Business role, enter your business name and type, then complete the onboarding wizard — it takes under five minutes.

items.q: What information is visible to the public vs. logged-in users?
items.a: Your business name, description, location, category, and opening hours are always public. Phone number, WhatsApp, website, and social media links are only revealed to logged-in users — protecting you from off-platform contact loss.

items.q: Can I showcase my services and photos?
items.a: Yes — add a full service menu with names, descriptions and price ranges, upload a cover photo plus a gallery, and set your daily opening hours. All visible on your public storefront.

items.q: How do I get featured on the landing page?
items.a: Upgrade to the Elite plan. Elite businesses are eligible for featured placement on the SkillHub landing page and appear at the top of search results in your category.

items.q: Is there a verification process for businesses?
items.a: Yes. After you complete onboarding our admin team reviews your profile. Verified businesses display a "✓ Verified" badge on their public page, increasing client trust significantly.
